summary.text: Luck Changing Golden Light Path is Calamity Luck Altar's killer move.

claims.text: Calamity Luck Altar shone with dazzling golden light. The golden light shot everywhere before joining together and making a path that stretched forward. Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace, stationed in Savage Wilderness Great World, let out a majestic light. That light shone on Calamity Luck Altar and created mysterious changes in the luck changing golden light path. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun flew out of Calamity Luck Altar and followed the golden light path into Primordial Domain. He made use of Calamity Luck Altar and Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace to enter Primordial Domain.

Immortal Zombie Giant Sun threw out Calamity Luck Altar and used luck changing golden light path. A dazzling path of golden light formed instantly. The immortals stepped on the path of light and let it bring them away as mountain-sized soul bombs with tadpole-like tails shot down. The bombs detonated with horrifying strength. The path shook intensely and dimmed rapidly, but the immortals escaped those soul bombs. From then on, every time the soul bombs attacked, Immortal Zombie Giant Sun used luck changing golden light path and moved the immortals away. The move is extremely profound. It can forcibly create a survival route in a hopeless situation. Soul beasts attacked and soul bombs detonated around the light path, and many of their attacks canceled each other, which kept the light path safe. Used earlier, Immortal Zombie Giant Sun could already have escaped with this move. This Door of Life and Death was extremely troublesome. Even when he used luck changing golden light path multiple times, he could not succeed.

Shen Shang completed the killer move Heaven Always Leaves A Way Out For People and created a narrow path. That path was long and winding, and it could not compare to luck changing golden light path. It pierced through the Door of Life and Death, and the immortals even saw the vague scene of the outside world at the end of the path.

After the Crazed Demon Cave battle, Fang Yuan’s information gains included Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s and Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s methods and combat systems, among them Calamity Luck Altar’s luck changing golden light path.

A golden path extended from deep within Northern Plains. It was Calamity Luck Altar’s strongest method. Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had purposely left Calamity Luck Altar in Longevity Heaven along with his own will and rank nine immortal essence. Using the vast number of Longevity Heaven’s luck path dao marks, the power of luck changing golden light path rose explosively and extended from Northern Plains to the battlefield. Giant Sun Immortal Venerable brought Light Emperor and You Tian Guang onto this path. Their speed rose immensely, and they went far away in just a moment. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and Great Love Immortal Venerable did not let them off, but their attacks were negated by each other due to the constant accidents that occurred around the golden path. Even a venerable’s attack, under the chaotic situation of the fused two heavens, was obstructed by soul beasts and black-white overturning clouds. This was the power of luck changing golden light path. Fang Yuan attacked several times but nearly caused accidents during heavenly secret Gu’s refinement. He had seen the power of luck changing golden light path from long ago, but this time it was so hard to deal with because of the amplification of Longevity Heaven’s dao marks. Both venerables gave chase into Northern Plains and eventually destroyed the luck changing golden light path. Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had been using his full strength to maintain it to resist the two venerables’ attacks.
